definitions.explanation: An airplane designed to carry passengers on commercial flights, as opposed to cargo planes or military aircraft.

examples.japanese: {旅客機|りょかくき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{空港|くうこう}→空港：00648_kuukou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{着陸|ちゃくりく}→着陸：05982_chakuriku⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The passenger plane landed at the airport.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大型|おおがた}→大型：03016_oogata⟧{旅客機|りょかくき}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{数百人|すうひゃくにん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{乗客|じょうきゃく}→乗客：03284_joukyaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{運|はこ}べる→運ぶ：01088_hakobu⟧。
examples.english: A large passenger plane can carry several hundred passengers.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新型|しんがた}→新型：19411_shingata⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{旅客機|りょかくき}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{燃費|ねんぴ}→燃費：18969_nenpi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧、⟦{環境|かんきょう}→環境：00174_kankyou⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{負荷|ふか}→負荷：14231_fuka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{少|すく}ない→少ない：01136_sukunai⟧。
examples.english: New passenger aircraft are fuel-efficient and place less burden on the environment.

notes:
USAGE:
The standard term for commercial passenger aircraft in news and formal contexts. In casual speech, ⟦{飛行機|ひこうき}→飛行機：00629_hikouki⟧ (airplane) is used without distinguishing between passenger and other types.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{大型|おおがた}→大型：03016_oogata⟧{旅客機|りょかくき} (large passenger plane)
- ⟦{小型|こがた}→小型：12460_kogata⟧{旅客機|りょかくき} (small passenger plane)
- ⟦{国際|こくさい}→国際：01406_kokusai⟧{旅客機|りょかくき} (international airliner)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{飛行機|ひこうき}→飛行機：00629_hikouki⟧: airplane — general term
- ⟦{航空機|こうくうき}→航空機：14008_koukuuki⟧: aircraft — formal, includes all types
- {貨物機|かもつき}: cargo plane — for freight
